label: 📸 Pipeline snapshot test
description: Compute a content hash + row/column count snapshot for the input frame. Compare against an expected snapshot (provided as a JSON string in params). Pass-through when matched; raises an error with the diff when not. Use as a pipeline regression guard.

expectedSnapshot.label: Expected snapshot JSON
expectedSnapshot.help: JSON object {"rows": N, "cols": M, "hash": "..."} produced by a previous run. Leave blank on first run; the artifact emits the snapshot to copy back into this param.

tolerance.label: Row count tolerance (%)
tolerance.help: 0 = exact match. 5 = allow ±5% row count drift before failing.
